context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 126 tested the new API Metrics Dashboard feature. All backend endpoints are working correctly: /api/system-health/api-metrics/overview, /api/system-health/api-metrics/timeseries, /api/system-health/api-metrics/top-endpoints, and /api/system-health/api-metrics/db-health. The middleware buffers metrics and flushes every 10 seconds, so generate traffic before querying. Frontend shows real-time charts, MongoDB status, and endpoint analysis. The rate limiter on /api/auth/login may trigger 429 during rapid testing - this is expected behavior.
